name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Brush | Super Lemon Haze
description: Supercharge your session with Fresh Canna’s 2G Live Resin Concentrate Brush – Super Lemon Haze, a zesty, high-energy sativa known for its vibrant citrus flavor and electrifying effects. This precision brush applicator makes it effortless to add potent, terp-loaded live resin to your joints, blunts, bowls, or dab rig. With bright lemon, tangy citrus, and herbal zest, Super Lemon Haze delivers an immediate cerebral rush, sparking creativity, motivation, and focus. Perfect for daytime use, this strain keeps you feeling fresh, focused, and full of life.
